You want to host yoga retreats but don’t know where to start?  
.  
This is the episode for you! I’ve been hosting sold out yoga retreats for years (only breaking for the pandemic) and they are my favorite venues for teaching yoga practices that have transformative effects on students’ lives.  
.  
Whether it’s local weekend retreats or international week-long retreats I have a knack for making the experience memorable and cultivating an environment for students to relax, let their hair down, and enjoy each other.  
.  
If you’ve ever thought, “I think I want to host a yoga retreat” listen to this week’s episode on the Essential Conversations for Yoga Teachers podcast, it’s #63 and it’ll lay out the foundation for you to get started hosting your own!  
.  
Got a question for the podcast? I answer teacher questions often, so share it with me! 💕
